head.description: Journeyman – Blueberry LemonadeBold, rich, and refreshingly groovy – Journeyman’s Blueberry Lemonade is a berry-fueled twist on the classic. 🫐🍋 Juicy blueberry sweetness is perfectly balanced with a splash of tart lemonade, delivering a smooth, stoney ride straight to nirvana.Vegan, Gluten Free and All-Natural · Made from scratch in-house with a recipe that complements the cannabis100mg THC · 2oz bottle10 capfuls = 10mg THC per capfulPortable and easy to enjoy, this 2oz bottle is made to move with you—whether you’re chilling at home, vibing with friends, or heading to a festival. Best served cold, Blueberry Lemonade brings a perfectly balanced mix of sweet and sour to elevate any occasion.👉 Available now at Highway 90 Dispensary in Marlton, NJ.If you’ve been searching for a “dispensary near me” with tasty cannabis beverages, Highway 90 has Journeyman Blueberry Lemonade plus a curated selection of premium cannabis flower, vapes, pre-rolls, and edibles.Edibles are created either by infusing cooking oil or butter with cannabis extract, or by mixing extract directly into other ingredients. Because edibles are digested and absorbed by your stomach and liver, the activation is often longer than other consumption methods, taking on average 45 minutes, and sometimes up to 2 hours. It is important to start low and slow when consuming edibles so you don't over do it. Take extra caution to ensure edibles are out of the reach of children.
